title: Nationwide weather in a narrow Android window
scenario: Open TodayWeather in Korea on a folded phone or in split screen. This example shows an offline map in an English (Korea) app window at a 0.85 system font scale.

steps.title: Read the available map modes
steps.instruction: Open the menu and choose National Weather. Read the labels above the map. Tap Wind direction/Wind speed to show both measurements for each city when data is available.
steps.caption: The three mode labels in the right-hand app pane.
steps.expected: The full label stays visible and can wrap when the window is narrow. The offline example shows city names.
